Bringing 'The Last Blossom' to Life: 'ODD TAXI' Team Returns with 'Housenka'
Following their acclaimed work ODD TAXI, director Baku Kinoshita and writer Kazuya Konomoto return with Housenka (The Last Blossom), an original movie from animation studio CLAP and produced by Pony Canyon. Premiering in Japan on October 10, 2025 after its world debut at the Annecy International Film Festival 2025, the movie presents a grounded human story rooted in the realities of everyday life, with the fantastical touch of a talking flower that adds a bit of whimsy to its candid themes. Manga 'Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito' Gets TV Anime
A television anime adaptation of Sekina Aoi and Ryou Tsuzura's Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito (My Crush's Crush) manga was announced on Friday. Tsuzura drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured above). Aoi (Gamers!) began serializing the romantic comedy manga, with illustrations by Tsuzura, in Young Animal Zero magazine in November 2022.
